  *What happened:* *What happened:* The Indian rupee closed nearly flat at **₹93.44 per US dollar** after hitting a seven-month high in early trading [S242, S407]. *Why it happened:* Robust foreign portfolio investor inflows into local equities boosted the local currency, though a stronger dollar index capped further gains [[Economic Times]](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/forex/forex-news/rupee-ends-flat-after-hitting-seven-month-high-as-firmer-dollar-offsets-inflows/articleshow/135959732.cms). *Why it matters:* Strong capital inflows provide macroeconomic stability, lowering imported inflation pressures for everyday consumers. *Who is affected:* Importers, travelers sending money home, and investors in Indian capital markets. *What happens next:* Watch foreign institutional investor flows and global crude oil price movements [[Rediff MoneyWiz]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxNQmkxVGZ5R2FIdTFwcm9sTjdXdWlOSzlKX1RFaGV5azVGYWt3UTlobThCYV9lOEZia244d0h2a19jMXVmMWNqR1dIY1BHdjNST0hmblBlbDdNRklzNUx6UHdfZUkxTW9HcDJmNUVZSVhKY3JhYUxrdGRxRkdub3FtSFF5SDFHX3hBU2laRG1SYm5BOUkyOHN4NGtLT19vM2NoOTZwMXpyakFyMUw2bktpSnZR?oc=5).   *What happened:* *What happened:* Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy announced the rollout of the Indiramma Family Insurance coverage, providing **₹5 lakh** in life insurance protection for one crore ration-card holding families across the state [S377, S475]. *Why it happened:* The state government structured the welfare program to financially safeguard vulnerable households against sudden tragedies [[Moneycontrol.com]](https://news.google.?oc=5). *Why it matters:* It delivers substantial social safety net benefits to lower-income families in Hyderabad and districts [S377, S475]. *Who is affected:* Over one crore families across Telangana holding eligible ration cards [S377, S475]. *What happens next:* Official distribution of insurance certificates begins in Siddipet [[Daily Pioneer]](https://news.google.?oc=5). [S29, S32, S263]
- 🔵 **NEW** — **SEBI Weighs New Margin Restrictions on Margin Trading Facility (MTF)**
  *What happened:* *What happened:* Capital market stocks like Angel One, 5paisa, and BSE slid up to **3%** as reports surfaced that SEBI is considering tighter margin frameworks to curb excessive retail speculation [[Livemint]](https://news.google.?oc=5). *Why it matters:* Stricter leverage rules could cool retail trading volumes in the derivatives and margin segments. *Who is affected:* Retail stock traders, brokers, and active investors. *What happens next:* Formal regulatory circular expected from SEBI regarding MTF norms.

## 🎓 Today's lesson
- **What is a P/E Ratio?** The Price-to-Earnings (P/E) ratio is a key financial metric used to evaluate whether a stock is overvalued or undervalued. It is calculated by dividing a company's current share price by its earnings per share (EPS). For example, if a company's stock trades at ₹1,000 and it earns ₹50 per share over a year, its P/E ratio is 20. A higher P/E generally means investors expect high future growth, while a lower P/E might indicate a bargain or a company facing slower growth prospects.
